complete_examples.text: The purpose of this paper is to develop a probabilistic model to select representative and realistic track irregularity sets from numerous data with higher efficiency and accuracy.

The aim of this paper is to develop a track irregularity probabilistic model (TIPM) to select the most representative track irregularity sets and to fully reveal the dynamic behaviors of vehicle/track systems on responses amplitude, characteristic frequencies and probability distributions.
